response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux-adjacent experience, but he falls short of this executive-level role in two critical areas: his German is listed as basic against a hard C1 requirement, and his career is almost entirely individual-contributor work with no demonstrated experience leading teams, managing client projects, or owning architecture governance at an organizational level. Python and UML expertise are also absent from his profile.
strengths: Broad full-stack and systems experience across many languages, platforms, and industries
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, D-language libraries, FOSS4G talks)
Solid engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and teaching/workshop experience
concerns: German at basic level vs. required minimum C1 — likely disqualifying for client-facing consulting
No formal leadership, team management, or client advisory track record
No evidence of Python, UML modeling, or requirements/security/compliance management
